correctness.rationale: Reconstructed actual cyclotomic factor-degree multiset: one degree-one factor and at each j factors of degree e_j=ord_(r^j)(p) with multiplicity r^(j−1)(r−1)/e_j for p!=r; for p=r it is (X−1)^(r^a). The contiguous-degree interval lemma proves sufficiency whenever each next factor degree <= prior attained total+1. For r=2 the order divides 2^(j−1); for r odd p≡1 mod r, lifting gives e_j=r^max(0,j−v_r(p−1)); for p≡−1 mod r, e_j=2r^max(0,j−v_r(p+1)), so if a>=2 and v_r(p+1)=1, degree r+1 is the first gap. For other p mod r, ord_r(p)>=3 so degree 2 is the first gap. Counts of reduced classes modulo r and r² produce stated PNT-in-AP densities. Independently reconstructed 425 (r,a,p) triples with r∈{2,3,5,7,11}, p<100, r^a<=200 by modular orders and bitset subsets; matches all first gaps. Finite checks are not all-prime proof.
